description: This file defines the IAsyncObservable<T> interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which generalizes the .NET IObservable interface for asynchronous consumption of stream items. It includes methods for subscribing asynchronously to a stream with optional filtering and sequence token.

classes.name: IAsyncObservable<T>
classes.description: An interface that allows asynchronous subscription to a stream of items, enabling consumers to process items asynchronously and manage their subscriptions.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync (IAsyncObserver<T>)
methods.description: Subscribes an asynchronous observer to the observable stream, returning a task that yields a subscription handle.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync (IAsyncObserver<T>, StreamSequenceToken?, string?)
methods.description: Subscribes an asynchronous observer to the stream starting from a specified sequence token and with optional filter data, returning a task that yields a subscription handle.
